# Senior Machine Learning Engineer

**YOUR MISSION AT VOI**

You will be joining a team focused on predicting the near-future demand for our vehicles. Specifically, where and when they will be needed, and how to handle this at scale for a fleet of 150 thousand vehicles spread across over more than 100 cities. This is a complex and meaningful problem from both an analytical as well as an engineering perspective, and you'll be handed ambiguous, high-leverage problems and are expected to reason from first principles about what to build — not a spec to implement.

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer at Voi, you'll work closely with a small, cross-functional team to design, build and maintain machine learning models. You will work on problems where you will get to utilize your skills in such interrelated disciplines as machine learning, AI engineering, software engineering, data science, optimization as well as data engineering.

*Your responsibilities will include:*

* Own and contribute to end-to-end machine learning and AI projects, in close collaboration with business stakeholders, and the rest of your team
* Formulating solution hypotheses, defining data requirements, prototyping, implementing in production, and continuously monitoring model health and business impact
* Maintain and improve Voi's machine learning platform to ensure our machine learning products adhere to state-of-the-art MLOps standards, with support from the team
* Work with colleagues to improve team processes and support mutual learning and knowledge sharing

**WHAT YOU NEED TO EMBARK**

We’re looking for a Machine Learning professional with experience from a fast-paced environment. In addition to being fluent in English, we believe the right person has:

* A clear focus on business value and user impact
* A strong analytical mindset, and comfortable setting up simplified first-principles models for complex problems, built on well-thought-through assumptions
* Forward-leaning attitude towards LLM-based and agentic approaches: you explore new AI tooling before it’s obviously the standard, and pair that curiosity with strong Python and software engineering fundamentals
* Experience contributing to projects from start to finish, from understanding business challenges to planning, building, launching and following up on results
* Hands-on experience with real-time inference and/or MLOps in one of the major cloud environments
* Experience writing production-quality, maintainable software
* Higher education in one of the mathematical sciences such as computer science, mathematics, physics, bioinformatics or with a similar data-centric degree

*Don’t meet every requirement? If you are excited about this role and our mission, and have relevant, transferable skills, we encourage you to apply – even if you don’t check every box.*

title: Software Engineer - Frontend – Helsing
content:
## Who we are

Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.

As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.

We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.

## The role

Collaborating closely with our dynamic team of product designers and engineers, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the foundation of frontend at Helsing. Embracing a hands-on approach, you'll not only lead by example, but also spearhead the development and expansion of a tight-knit team that works across a wide-range of internal teams and products. Your primary emphasis will be on enhancing usability, creating re-usable foundations for multiple front-ends and optimising the end-user experience across the entire company.

## The day-to-day

* Review code contributions, proposals, and RFCs from colleagues. At Helsing we strongly believe that unblocking others takes precedence over spending more time on your own work.
* Own the user interface end-to-end, from early wireframes and prototypes through to performant, production-ready code. You'll work closely with product and UX colleagues to shape how users interact with our tools. We have relatively few frontend engineers at Helsing; this means that we operate at a high level of autonomy and there are plenty of opportunities for impactful work.
* Propose and implement new features, capabilities, tooling, visualizations, or even full products across our stack. We encourage our engineers to look beyond their immediate team for missed opportunities, and to speak up when they identify one.
* Establish and evolve our React component library, ensuring consistency, reusability, and alignment with our visual design standards across multiple front-ends.
* Collaborate with others beyond your team and share knowledge with the wider frontend community at Helsing. Contribute to establishing our frontend engineering standards. Build or adopt tools that help enforce these standards, or make our frontend engineers more efficient in a different way.
* Become a mentor, find a mentee, and help support and develop our interviewing pipeline. The people make or break the company, and we want as many engineers as possible to be part of fostering and growing the organisation.
* Share your experience and technical know-how with other Helsingers. We host tech talks, get together for smaller "le

# Staff Mobile Engineer - React Native (x/f/m)

Unlimited Contract

Paris

Engineering

## About Doctolib

We’re a B Corp company committed to build together the healthcare we all dream of.

More than 3,000 Doctolibers in France, Germany, Italy, and the Netherlands are helping to improve the daily lives of care teams with a new generation of technologies and services.

At the same time, Doctolib is helping over 90 million patients to effectively manage their health and provide quick and easy access to optimal healthcare.

## Job description

## What you'll do

We are looking for a Staff Mobile Engineer with strong expertise in React Native to join our Patient domain at Doctolib.

As a Mobile Staff Engineer, your mission will be to work on transforming the Doctolib mobile app into a full health companion powered by AI to help people lead healthier lives. You will play a key role in improving the quality, UX, and depth of our mobile application while contributing significantly to the technical foundations of mobile development for the team.

Working in the tech team at Doctolib involves building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients. We work in feature teams in an agile environment, while collaborating with product, design, and business teams.

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

* Establish and evolve mobile architecture patterns and technical standards for the patient domain
* Drive technical excellence across mobile development, ensuring high code quality and best practices
* Contribute to the technical roadmap and guide architectural decisions for the mobile platform
* Mentor and support mobile engineers in implementing robust, scalable solutions
* Lead by example in building features that enhance the user experience and app performance

### About our tech environment

# Senior Frontend Developer (f/m/d)

Remote Germany, Berlin, Hamburg, München, Prague

Full-time

Permanent employee

## What to expect

We are a startup digital agency, and no two projects, clients, or even days look the same.

In ecommerce we build on Shopify and Liquid and Next.js, with custom AWS microservices and apps that take Shopify well past the defaults. 

On the marketing side we build highly customised sites in Next.js and React, with careful design and animation and a real focus on how the page performs and feels. 

In automotive we build full platforms, from stock-car locators to configurators and more. Across all of it, we bring AI into the work through our own products.

Here nothing will be fixed. You will work across changing projects and settings, on long builds that run for months and shorter spikes to figure out how a business can actually use AI, and you will help us rethink how agency work is done.

Sound like your kind of place? Here is what we need from you.

## Your competencies

Mindset

Is your goal to deliver great software, whether the problem is easy or hard? Do you push deeper than most to find the right solution, not just the first one that works? Then you are the person we need. 

Responsibility

You own what you build, all the way through, not just until it ships and becomes someone else's problem. The parts that go smoothly and the parts that get messy are both yours to see through. You bring your ideas, experience and your curiosity, you use AI to build better and faster, and you stand behind what you put your name on.

Drive

By now the drive is a track record, not a promise. You have years of hard problems behind you and it shows. You understand the whole stack, or you close any gap in it fast, and the hard problems are the ones you go looking for. You are the one who takes the piece nobody else can crack and finds a way through, then leaves the ground solid enough for everyone else to build on. If the hardest part of a project is not the part you reach for, this is not your seat.

What you bring to the table:

* You work across crafts, not in a corner. You are close with developers, designers, and strategists, and you would rather build in the open than behind a wall.
* You make the team better. You speak up when something can be sharper, and you share what you learn instead of sitting on it.
* You care whether the client wins. You focus on the quality of the product and the experience, not just the ticket in front of you.

## What You Can Look Forward To

What you will actually do:

We build complex, end-to-end products for both big-name and niche clients. You are the strongest technical hands on the team, the one the hardest problems land on.

Day to day, that means:

* Taking the hardest parts of the build and shipping them, the pieces others get stuck on.
* Laying the foundations: the architecture, the patterns, and the setup that let the rest of the team move fast and safely.

# Associate Engineer (Front End)

* Calgary / Canada
* Remote
* Engineering
* R0018332

## The Role

**The role**

As an Associate Engineer, you will help supercharge small businesses by writing clean, reliable code and delivering well-defined features that directly support our product outcomes. Working alongside senior engineers, you will solve day-to-day technical challenges, design tests to ensure high quality, and debug code using logs and dashboards to maintain system health.

By bringing curiosity and a data-driven mindset, you will help keep our systems robust and aligned with customer needs. You will take ownership of your work, proactively share knowledge, and contribute to a supportive, inclusive environment where continuous learning drives success.

**The team & how they connect**

Our engineering teams work collaboratively to build and maintain scalable technology for small businesses. We value open communication, thoughtful discussion, and working together across functions to remove blockers and solve problems efficiently.

**The team is currently working on**

* Developing front end features using HTML, CSS, and modern JavaScript (ES6+) with React
* Integrating front end applications with back end REST APIs
* Utilising modern delivery and collaboration practices such as pair programming and continuous improvement
* Exploring artificial intelligence tools to increase efficiency and automate routine tasks

**Where and how you can work**

We support a flexible working model that empowers you to balance your professional and personal life. You will have the option to work in a hybrid capacity, combining the focus of remote work with the collaboration of our office spaces and team boost days to foster connection and alignment.

**Here are some of the things we are looking for**

* Hands-on experience building web applications using modern JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
* Practical exposure to React and an understanding of connecting front end interfaces to REST APIs
* Comfort navigating version control using Git and participating in pull request code reviews
* A sharp eye for UI/UX details, quality standards, and confidence debugging code locally
* Curiosity about leveraging AI tools to streamline everyday workflows and tasks
* Familiarity with TypeScript, testing frameworks (like Jest or Cypress), component libraries, or web accessibility principles is a plus

Apply even if your experience isn't a perfect match! At Xero, we hire based on your skills, passion, and the unique perspective you can bring to enhance our culture and team.

**Compensation & Total Rewards**

At Xero, we value the impact and skills you bring to the team. We believe in a Total Package philosophy - ensuring your value is recognised through a holistic lens that includes base salary, performance incentives, and world-class benefits.

**The expected base salary range for this role is $109,100 - $136,400 CAD**
